trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum for earning all 54 other trophies. Plan a roadmap through the story chapters first, then clean up collectibles, activities and side content; this one pops on its own when the checklist is full.
sources: Official PlayStation GTA VI trophy list (playstation.com)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission 'Gone Fishing' with Lucia and Jason to start the story. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete all of Chapter 1's missions. Follow the main story markers; the chapter trophy is awarded when the final Chapter 1 mission ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story-progress trophy: just keep following the main missions until the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Another story-progress trophy — finish the chapter's missions in order.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last story chapter before the finale. Awarded automatically at the end of the chapter.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the game. This gold trophy is the story closer — finish the last main mission to earn it.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Breakfast Run'. Follow the mission marker on the map during Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete 'The Cartel Heist'. A main story mission in Chapter 2 — start it from the map or mission menu.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Child's Play'. Story mission; no special requirements beyond finishing it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Headliners'. Story mission in Chapter 3; finish it to take the trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete 'VCIA Takedown'. Story mission tied to the airport (VCIA); follow the marker and finish it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete 'Operation Savage Glory'. A Chapter 4 story mission — finish it to earn the trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This gold trophy needs everything: story done, plus collectibles, activities, properties and side content tracked in the pause menu's 100% checklist.
sources: Official PlayStation GTA VI trophy list (playstation.com)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts trigger automatically from jumps, drifts and near-misses in any vehicle; the counter is in the pause menu. Park a fast car near a long ramp and repeat.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: races, drone races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling, darts, golf, tennis (check the activities list in-game). One attempt each is enough.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit each range, use cover and aim for headshots; gold requires near-perfect accuracy, so retry until the medal pops.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Start each drone race from the map icon, learn the route, and beat the best time. Practice laps do not count — you need the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter street races, air races and sea races from the map; each different race you win counts once toward the 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Visit the fishing spot, start the challenge against Cal, and land a bigger catch than his to win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at a cabinet in an arcade. Play any cabinet game to the end (or until it clears) — one full game is enough.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Find Andy (the rehab-group stranger) on the map, do his missions in order, and finish his last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Work through Kenton's stranger missions across Leonida and finish the last one.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's biker strand. Finish Billy's mission chain; the trophy pops on his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each stranger (blue ? marker) offers a chain; finishing 8 full chains earns this silver trophy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand of stranger missions — the trophy is his last mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Work Tyrone's missions to the end of his strand.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Missable flag: some spots are only reachable during early chapters, so sweep the map as you go rather than leaving it to post-game.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand involves tracking a special animal; follow his missions and take the unique target down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found around the map and bought in shops; complete any 3 full sets to earn this silver trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is a social-media app in the phone — visit 100 different spots and post from each.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the timed skill tasks (parachuting, flight school, etc.); finish any 50 of them.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level together with your partner. Get to 4 stars while co-op partnered (switch character in the pause menu), then escape the cops until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With a partner in session, hit 3 convenience stores in a row while keeping at least one star.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Steal and drive cars you haven't seen before — the discovery ping and counter are in the pause menu garage list.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus (dead-eye) and drop 5 enemies before it ends — use a group of enemies and a high-damage weapon.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (the airport). During or after the airport mission, leave the airport in a vehicle the mission did not hand you — steal one on the tarmac.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Survive/deal with Rhino tanks ('Kinda hot in these Rhinos'). Use explosives or a tank of your own; the trophy triggers when you take one down in the intended way.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Use stealth: take out the cameras, sneak past guards, grab the loot. If you are spotted, reload the last checkpoint and retry — flagged missable because a botched attempt can lock the clean rob.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit the big banks' vaults with the required crew/drill approach and get away clean; 5 successful vault robberies earn this silver trophy.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Blow the truck's door (sticky bombs or RPG), grab the cash, and lose the cops before the escape timer.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every one of the 52 named areas must be discovered on foot or by vehicle. Use the map fog; fly a plane over the whole state to reveal large regions fast.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find each gang's marked illegal business on the map, clear it, and take the take — one per gang.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean Beach bar, order a cocktail at the bar, and drink it there.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Start inside a car showroom, wreck the display cars, and drive out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Enter the bowling alley, play bowling with the follow-through prompt, and finish the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — progress the co-op story moment with your partner until the scene/trophy triggers.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices (for better or worse) — the game counts your story decisions (PSN tracks a hidden count). Make the required number of choices in missions; the trophy pops when the count is reached.
sources: Official PlayStation GTA VI trophy list (playstation.com)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on a second attempt. The game flags a retry-then-succeed moment in a mission; failing once then passing triggers it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — find one of the game's UFO/easter-egg sightings at the marked spot at the right time of night.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — drive past a pedestrian and hit them with a melee swing from the car window.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Buy Marked Bills jobs from contacts, run the laundering missions, and bank $250,000 of laundered cash.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, cars and upgrades — total shop spending of $100,000 earns the trophy.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every safehouse/garage property for sale across Leonida — the map shows them; 8 garages total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the phone and register 10 of your owned vehicles.
